task.title: Project exact finite recurrence occurrences
task.objective: Complete issue https://github.com/Knosence9/project-vela/issues/861 by projecting one caller-selected zero-based occurrence from a validated durable recurrence.
acceptance_criteria: Return exact recurrence identity, goal, offset, instant, and definition revision for every authored coordinate.
Reject offsets at or above the finite occurrence count with typed evidence preserving the requested offset and count.
Keep projection read-only and free of persisted occurrence identity, clocks, catch-up policy, dispatch, retries, and execution.

attempts.diagnostic: The focused recurrence-store test failed with an unresolved RecurrenceOccurrenceLookupError import and a missing occurrence_at method.
attempts.patch: Added first, interior, final, maximum-instant, and out-of-range projection tests.

attempts.diagnostic: Callers needed a bounded way to derive one authored coordinate without converting arithmetic into durable lifecycle state.
attempts.patch: Added RecurrenceOccurrence, a typed out-of-range error, occurrence_at over checked indexed arithmetic, and ADR-0038.

attempts.diagnostic: The initial CodeRabbit run was rate limited and therefore could not satisfy the substantive review gate.
attempts.patch: Waited through the cooldown, deliberately resumed review within the shared budget, and merged only after exact-head CI and zero unresolved threads.

outcome.summary: A validated recurrence can project one exact authored occurrence with complete inert provenance and typed finite-bound failures.

lessons: Zero-based occurrence offsets map directly onto the immutable recurrence anchor.
Projection provenance should include the definition revision even when definitions are currently immutable.
An occurrence projection is inert evidence, not durable identity or execution permission.
False-green rate-limited reviews require a later substantive exact-head run.
